title: The Unsuitable Yield Promise
brief: A simulated Private Bank client asks for a high-yield product that conflicts with the recorded risk profile and liquidity needs.
objective: Keep advice fair, clear and aligned with the client's documented needs.

nodes.speaker: Private Banking Client
nodes.message: I need a guaranteed high return and access to all my money next month. Put me into the product your colleague mentioned today.

artifact.title: Client investment request
artifact.body: Recorded profile is conservative with near-term liquidity needs; requested product has material market and lock-up risk.

choices.label: Reassess needs, explain the risks clearly and recommend only suitable options.
choices.consequence: The recommendation process remains client-centred and evidence-based.

choices.label: Proceed because the client explicitly requested it.
choices.consequence: Client insistence is treated as a substitute for suitability assessment.

choices.label: Describe the return prominently and leave the liquidity risk in the small print.
choices.consequence: The communication is unbalanced and obscures a material client risk.
